title: The delta's acceptance evidence is missing
description: The delta's acceptance evidence is missing. The sprint requires every command in the acceptance table to print '1 passed' and the required validation (just lint, just test, cargo test -p sc-jev-backends) to run. This review had no shell and could not run any of them, including the new test test_malformed_body_hint_is_fix_the_body. Static reading supports the hint fix but does not meet the execution requirement. This is a review-tooling gap, not a sprint defect. It is still a Blocking gap under the gate policy until the evidence exists.
